config:
# E3 simulated patients (docs/ranking-plan.md §9). Changing how patients are generated: bump split_version and
# add a decisions.md row.

split_version = "v1"
dev_seed = 1
test_seed = 2
diseases_per_side = 500

# Probability of keeping a phenotype whose annotation has no frequency (T48 (8)); unlike the ranker's 0.9, so
# E3 does not favour the frequency-based method.
missing_frequency_keep = 0.5
# Gong 2018: a simulated patient has at least 3 phenotypes; redraw up to max_attempts times.
min_terms = 3
max_attempts = 100
# Köhler 2009 / Masino 2014: noise adds half as many unrelated terms as the patient has.
noise_ratio = 0.5
